concepts.def: Post-Civil War rebuilding under 13th-15th Amendments; ended with Hayes-Tilden compromise withdrawing federal troops.
Southern state segregation laws after Reconstruction; legitimised by Plessy v Ferguson 'separate but equal' doctrine 1896.
National Association for the Advancement of Colored People founded by W.E.B. Du Bois; pursued legal strategy.
CORE-organised integrated buses challenging segregated interstate travel; attacked in Anniston and Birmingham.
King-led march to Montgomery; 'Bloody Sunday' beatings at Edmund Pettus Bridge pressured Voting Rights Act.
Supreme Court ruling establishing constitutional right to abortion; landmark of second-wave feminism.
